value.rationale: A minimally defected two-community complete network has a closed, all-positive-weight all-size leader-placement phase diagram with an unexpected sharp small-part restriction (p=3,4,5), exact q boundaries, switch conductance, objective and optimizer multiplicities. This specific natural graph optimization is not a routine reparameterization of an unmodified or deleted-cross-edge case, and the exact threshold is a reusable network design benchmark.
